purpose: 10-card structural validation of the shared screen-safety remediation. Tests known tech_workspace leaks plus creator_workflow, digital_play, and campaign-planning cross-hobby cases. All use Standard FLUX to test whether physical-first / hidden-screen composition removes UI/text leakage without Klein style drift.
qa_focus: no front-facing monitor/laptop/tablet/phone display used as a semantic canvas
zero readable UI, code, terminal text, editing timelines, waveforms, menus, dashboards, chat, labels, icons, or text-like interface structures
recognition must survive through human action and physical tools/devices
vlogging must contain no background monitor at all
video editing and game streaming should read from physical editing/broadcast controls while monitor faces remain hidden
technology cards should read through hardware/prototype/sensor/robot/device interactions rather than screens
global title/caption suppression must remain intact

decision_gate.systemic_screen_leakage: At least 9/10 PASS-or-MINOR and zero repeated readable UI/text leakage across more than one archetype.
decision_gate.tech_workspace: No more than one MINOR screen artifact among the five tech_workspace cards; no readable code/UI FAIL.
decision_gate.cross_hobby: vlogging, video_editing, pc_gaming, game_streaming and digital_marketing must not reintroduce front-facing interface semantics.
decision_gate.scale: Do not start 50/100 automatically. If screen leakage repeats, diagnose which structural route still places a display face in the composition.
